convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom calls for non-standard indicators (Lucky and BuySell indicators) whose internal logic is unavailable, making automatic conversion unreliable without reverse-engineering the custom indicator logic

other_exits: Signal reversal closes opposite position and opens new position in reverse direction

custom_logic_notes: EA relies entirely on two custom indicators (Lucky and BuySell) loaded via iCustom. Entry signals are derived from custom buffer values that cannot be reconstructed without the indicator source code. The EA appears to operate as a signal-reversal system where an opposing signal closes the current position and opens a new one in the reverse direction. No SL/TP is set natively - exits are purely signal-driven.
python_conversion_notes: Cannot auto-convert because two custom indicators (Lucky, BuySell) are loaded via iCustom with unknown buffer logic and parameters. The indicator .ex5/.mq5 source files must be obtained and their algorithms reverse-engineered into Python before any trading logic can be replicated. Without the indicator source, signal generation is a black box. Position management and order execution are straightforward market orders with signal-reversal exit logic.
